entries.review_notes: Full native window read. Reroll is explicitly priced at one token; server result is display authority. Weak mailbox ownership, queue bound 16, capability-dependent intents, checked row-to-slot conversion and failed-send/pending handling were checked. No native UI execution.

Full codec/mock-transport play tests read. UI label, command selection, pending result handling and capability-dependent actions are covered in source. This is neither a running Windows UI nor PostgreSQL qualification; tests not executed.

Full presentation model read. Current token balance and one-token reroll text are consistent with the new contract. Offers, selected bounty, weekly results, availability and frozen rewards are rendered from server data; no authority is inferred from presentation. No execution.

Full 1123-line composed PostgreSQL test source read. Runtime fixtures, current capability/pin/fence setup, real kill and duplicate-death paths, original command receipts, paid reroll, unchanged value snapshot on zero-token refusal, weekly reset/results and talisman/currency paths were traced. Privileged fixture SQL and direct funding are explicitly not legal-player producer proof. PostgreSQL tests not executed.

Full 350-line Elite integration test source read. A completed fixture is claimed through the actual owner to obtain the now-required reroll token. Explicit rare-draw/board/premium fixture inputs, serial/replay dust guards, active Elite state and real vitals/XP owner calls were distinguished from production acquisition proof. No SQL execution.

Full immutable receipt projection read. Historical daily_reroll_at is always zero; current token balance is preserved from the committed view. Exact refusal mapping, bounded board/list/shop projection, delivery counts and capability-dependent Elite/weekly representation were checked. No claim of unchanged wire bytes across the retired-field upgrade.

Full 983-line rules owner read. Clone/apply/publish refuses atomically; reroll requires one current token and emits one spent effect without a time exception. Removed historical timer is compatible with serde unknown fields. Completed-token grant limits, committed weekly settlement, vocation/difficulty, three eligible unique offers, preferred/unwanted policy, checked frozen rewards, selection serial, bounded rarity, list/shop/promotion/talisman behavior were examined with actual durable caller. No runtime execution.

All 1609 lines read. Timestamp-independent zero-token refusal and a funded reroll, removed timer JSON compatibility, gates and level loss, XP/reward limits, clone preservation, period settlement, expansion, preferred/unwanted, shop/cosmetics/talisman and Elite rarity/frozen rewards were examined. Synthetic catalogue and supplied draws are test inputs. Tests not executed.

Full current contract read and related to native UI, pure rules, unchanged SQL owner and reply projection. Every reroll costs one durable token; the historical timer is zero and action 12 remains retired. Capability, action, limits, receipts, committed-calendar and provisional Elite constraints were checked. This contract is current design authority, not observed deployment behavior.

Full wire declaration read. Historical scalar retained with zero meaning, action/result fields, token and reward widths and bounded nested structures were checked against the prose contract and actual projection. No protocol regeneration or end-to-end run.
